verdict.rationale: Poke documents a public API, but it is a single versioned endpoint (POST /api/v1/inbound/api-message, bearer auth) for sending messages into Poke from apps, scripts and automation tools. Users can drive the conversational assistant programmatically, but the surface is narrow and thinly specified. Missing for 10: broader API surface beyond inbound messaging, machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), interactive reference, sandbox, stability/sunset policy, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Poke API allows you to send messages programmatically from your applications, scripts, and automation tools.
Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.
Poke's API is a single documented endpoint on a versioned path (POST https://poke.com/api/v1/inbound/api-message, bearer auth)
